name: claude-code-kit
description: Guard hooks, tool plugins with their skills inside, research subagents, an inbox monitor and an MCP template for Claude Code.

plugins.name: request-guard
plugins.description: Every request to a public website counted and spaced (PreToolUse on Bash, PowerShell, WebFetch and browser navigation; back-off on 403/429/503), plus a paced fetcher and the fetch-paced skill.

plugins.name: session-guard
plugins.description: Keeps a session-notes file fresh: a Stop hook blocks a tool-using turn once while the notes are stale, untouched or missing; PreCompact records compactions. Includes the session-notes skill.

plugins.name: action-guard
plugins.description: Refuses or asks about actions against one web application: writes, protected paths, browser form input and JavaScript on its pages, and listed MCP tools. Policy in a JSON file.

plugins.name: video-digest
plugins.description: Read an online video without watching it: local Whisper transcript, caption cross-check with numeric disagreements flagged, timestamped keyframes; the skill says when to use it and how to read the report.

plugins.name: docx-pages
plugins.description: Page counts for Word documents from a real LibreOffice render, with a --limit check that never passes on an unknown count; measurement only.

plugins.name: screenshot
plugins.description: Screenshots and timed bursts on macOS, Windows and Linux, capped at 1800 px, with change detection; the skill reads images in a subagent so they never flood the context.

plugins.name: call-recorder
plugins.description: Record a call on a Mac as stereo (you left, the other party right, via BlackHole) and get a speaker-labeled whisper.cpp transcript; consent first.

plugins.name: photos-find
plugins.description: Find a photo in the macOS Photos library by the words Live Text found in it and read them without opening the image; read-only.

plugins.name: session-forensics
plugins.description: Find and audit Claude Code transcripts: which session did X, where the context and tokens went, and whether sessions keep a notes file, knowledge base and memory current unasked.

plugins.name: research-agents
plugins.description: Subagents for research: researcher (paced, sourced findings), verifier (claim-by-claim document check with its own memory), browser-reader (read-only Chrome) and frame-reader (images in, text out).

plugins.name: inbox-monitor
plugins.description: A plugin monitor that streams ntfy messages (optional HMAC check) or new lines of a file into an interactive session, one notification per event.

plugins.name: kb-mcp
plugins.description: A local, private knowledge-base MCP server over your own folders of Markdown and text notes: kb_search, kb_get, kb_recent, kb_reindex, kb_status over a SQLite index (BM25 via FTS5, optional Ollama embeddings, adaptive rank fusion) that refreshes itself. Stdlib Python 3.8+.

plugins.name: hivemind
plugins.description: Your Ollama models as Claude Code tools: health, list_models, ask_local, route (quick/interactive/quality tiers with fallback) and embed, from a stdlib MCP server. Local-model output is advisory.
